name: flue-host
title: Flue 2 Host

origin.source: Real @flue/runtime@2 (not a shim): the agent is the exported function returning its instructions, composed by hooks (useModel/useSkill/useTool/usePersistentState) with Valibot tool input/output and run({ data }); booted in-process with start() from @flue/runtime/node and driven via init()/dispatch()/read(), keyless through pi's fauxProvider

comparison.purpose: Two ways to pair Flue 2 with a state machine. machine-owned.ts: the email-drafter machine owns model calls, branches, pauses, and legality; the Flue agent is a conversational shell with start_workflow/resume_workflow bridge tools. flue-owned.ts: Flue's hooks own per-step model, skills, tools, and persistent state, and a ~10-line steps machine replaces the docs' usePersistentState('step', ...) string — transitions become declared, the step switch exhaustive, and events inferred via EventFromLogic.

starters: Draft an email telling the team the deploy pipeline is twice as fast, then send it.
